descriptionChirho: Qal active: to seize persons and carry them away as captives or prisoners of war, used of military conquest and deportation.
Nifal passive: to be seized and carried away as a captive or prisoner, describing the experience of those captured in war or exile.
Qal active participle used as an agentive noun: a person who captures and holds others as prisoners.
Qal passive participle used as a substantive noun: a person who has been taken captive, a prisoner of war.
